options.name: enabled
options.description: Specifies whether to enable LLDP or not.

options.name: interfaces
options.description: Specifies interfaces for which we want to enable LLDP.

options.name: max_neighbors_per_port
options.description: Specify the maximum number of LLDP neighbors for which LLDP data is retained.

options.name: reinitiate_delay
options.description: Specify the minimum time interval, in seconds, an LLDP port waits before re-initializing an LLDP transmission. This parameter value should lie between 0-65535.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), this option creates LLDP configuration on specified remote host. If C(absent), this option disables LLDP configuration on the device (if it exists).

options.name: tx_delay
options.description: Specify the minimum time delay, in seconds, between successive LLDP frame transmissions. This parameter value should lie between 0-65535.

options.name: tx_hold
options.description: This parameter value should lie between 0-65535.

options.name: tx_interval
options.description: Interval (in seconds) at which LLDP packets are sent to neighbors. This parameter value should lie between 0-65535.
